chunks: Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad, from Mu‘allā ibn Muhammad, from Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn ‘Alī, from ‘Alī ibn Ja‘far, who said:
I heard Abā al-Hasan عليه السلام saying: While the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله was seated, an angel entered upon him having twenty-four faces.

So the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said to him: My beloved Jibrā’īl, I have not seen you in a form like this. The angel said: I am not Jibrā’īl, O Muhammad. Allah, Mighty and Majestic, has sent me to marry the light to the light. He said: Who to whom? He said: Fāṭimah to ‘Alī.

He said: So when the angel turned away, there was written between his shoulders: Muhammad is the Messenger of Allah; ‘Alī is his legatee. Then the Messenger of Allah صلى الله عليه وآله said: Since when has this been written between your shoulders? He said: From before Allah created Adam by twenty-two thousand years.

key_terms.آدَمَ: Adam عليه السلام, whose creation is used as the point before which this inscription already existed.
key_terms.النُّورَ: Light; here referring to the exalted, luminous reality of the holy figures.
key_terms.عَلِيٍّ: ‘Alī عليه السلام, to whom Fāṭimah عليها السلام is joined.
key_terms.فَاطِمَةَ: Fāṭimah عليها السلام, whom the angel names in the heavenly marriage.
key_terms.مَلَكٌ: An angelic being sent with a divine mission.

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about the marriage of Fāṭimah عليها السلام and ‘Alī عليه السلام and the pre-eternal status of ‘Alī’s وصاية?
ai.summary: This narration describes an angelic announcement of the marriage of Sayyidah Fāṭimah عليها السلام to Imam ‘Alī عليه السلام, presented as the joining of light with light. It also affirms the pre-temporal inscription of the Messenger’s صلى الله عليه وآله وسلم prophethood and Imam ‘Alī’s عليه السلام wilayah and وصاية before the creation of Adam عليه السلام.
